connector.name: Borough NYC Real Estate API
connector.registryDescription: Search NYC rentals and sales, property details, building data, and market analytics
connector.summary: Hosted at borough.qwady.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.qwady, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BOROUGH_API_KEY
env.description: Your Borough API key (get one free at https://borough.qwady.app/pricing)
